description: Search Eniro.se (Sweden's business & phone directory) listings by keyword/category and city, or fetch full business profiles by direct URL/ID.

businessUrls.description: Direct Eniro business URLs (e.g. https://www.eniro.se/<name>/<id>/firma) or bare numeric business IDs to fetch, one per line. Use the 'sourceUrl' or 'businessId' field from search results.
businessUrls.title: Business profile URLs or IDs (mode=detail)

city.description: Swedish city or town to search in, e.g. 'Stockholm', 'Göteborg', 'Malmö' (mode=search). Leave empty to search all of Sweden nationwide.
city.title: City

customQuery.description: Free-text category or keyword not in the curated list above, e.g. 'skorstensfejare' or 'IT-konsult' (mode=search). Takes priority over 'Category / keyword' when set. Use correct Swedish spelling with å/ä/ö -- Eniro's own search does not fuzzy-match ASCII-folded keywords.
customQuery.title: Custom category/keyword (overrides selection above)

fetchDetails.description: For each search result, also visit its business profile page to collect rating, opening hours, website, description, coordinates, images, and full category chain. Slower, but far richer output (mode=search).
fetchDetails.title: Fetch full business profiles

hasWebsiteOnly.description: Only return businesses that list a website (mode=search). Requires 'Fetch full business profiles' to be enabled, since websites only appear on detail pages.
hasWebsiteOnly.title: Only businesses with a website

maxItems.description: Hard cap on the number of business records to return.
maxItems.title: Max items

minRating.description: Only return businesses rated at least this many stars, e.g. '4' for 4.0+ (mode=search). Requires 'Fetch full business profiles' to be enabled, since ratings only appear on detail pages.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

mode.description: What to fetch: search by keyword/category & city, or fetch full business profiles from direct URLs/IDs.
mode.title: Mode

query.description: Business category or keyword to search for. Pick a common category from the list, or choose 'Custom' and type your own in the field below (mode=search).
query.title: Category / keyword

ratedOnly.description: Only return businesses that have at least one customer rating (mode=search). Requires 'Fetch full business profiles' to be enabled, since ratings only appear on detail pages.
ratedOnly.title: Only businesses with ratings

sortBy.description: How to order the returned results (mode=search). Applied after fetching, since Eniro's own listing order is relevance-based.
sortBy.title: Sort order

title: Eniro Scraper Input
